title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
abstract: arXiv:2606.05327v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. translated_title: 具有最优传输势的多边缘流匹配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.05327v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：流匹配（FM）已成为学习两个经验分布之间动态传输映射的强大框架。然而，较少被探索的是中间观测边缘分布的情况，这些分布有助于约束端点之间的流。这种“多边缘”机制对于许多科学领域中动态系统的时间演化建模至关重要，这些领域可以采样顺序分布。我们通过一种新颖方法解决此问题，该方法利用FM与动态最优传输（OT）之间的联系，通过动态OT作用中的势项将流柔和地引导向中间边缘分布。通过扩展条件FM学习目标以纳入这些势，我们推导出一种高效、无模拟的多边缘FM算法，该算法在学习流的时空动态方面提供了相当大的灵活性。我们展示了最先进的性能并进行训练。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合动态最优传输势的多边缘流匹配方法，通过软约束中间边缘分布，实现高效且无模拟的时空动态学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimarginal flow matching method incorporating dynamic optimal transport potentials, softly steering flows toward intermediate marginals for efficient, simulation-free spatiotemporal dynamics learning.
